body:
Reviewed PR #1 ("Plan containing-repository context for historical receipts", base 154440f3 → head 1aacfd37): all 19 changed files / 128 KB full diff read page-by-page (17/17 pages delivered and assessed). The change is additive only — a first GitHub Actions review workflow (pinned reusable receiver + evidence gate script), three narrow rooted .gitignore rules, append-only ledgers (receipts, session-mycology, kanban events), evidence/diagnostic JSONs including a compiled arity probe outside all build paths, and planning cards/docs. No production, test, schema, or ESM-export code is touched.

Deterministic evidence: all six gates attempted at the exact head with clean checkout — diff_stat/diff_hygiene/install/lint/build pass; `pnpm test` fails (exit 1) on the pre-existing discovery-test `exec_at.cljs$core$IFn$_invoke$arity$2` TypeError. Because the diff makes zero deletions and never touches the failing files (verified byte-unchanged in the evidence and stack), this red suite is an honestly documented baseline blocker, not a change-introduced regression. The gate script's observed execution matches its written form, and the new .gitignore cache rule is empirically confirmed by clean_checkout=true.

Confirmed findings: none — APPROVE. Design claims in the cards were spot-checked against source (validate-line 2-arity, record-errors 1-arity, legacy-required-keys includes :repo, single-arity delayed-git test double with 9 repos / 5 ms / 3 assertions) and are accurate; the prior Markdown setext issue is correctly fixed.

Non-blocking notes: (1) needs-human security question — the new job forwards ETA_MU_APP_PRIVATE_KEY while its gates run PR-head package scripts; whether the SHA-pinned external receiver keeps the key out of those steps cannot be verified from this repository (canonical org pattern; worth confirming receiver-side env isolation). (2) The workflow's install-failure branch (exit-125 path) and the fork-PR path (empty secrets) are untested branches with no demonstrated failure. (3) Committed evidence files disclose local absolute paths (/home/err/...) — trivial, no secrets. (4) Merged state must still respect the PR's own stated gate: the baseline test failure blocks delivery independently of this review.
